mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the unemployment rate signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing corporate earnings and consumer demand, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of rising unemployment (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals weakening household demand, which reduces corporate revenues and earnings, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of falling real personal consumption expenditures (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the federal funds rate above 2.5% signals a tightening monetary cycle, raising discount rates and reducing equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of tightening monetary policy (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the unemployment rate above 5.5% signals a significant labor market deterioration, reducing corporate earnings and consumer demand, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of rising unemployment above 5.5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) below $400 billion signals a significant demand contraction, reducing corporate revenues and earnings, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of falling real personal consumption expenditures below $400 billion (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the industrial production index (INDPRO) below 100 signals a significant supply contraction, reducing corporate earnings and increasing input costs, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of falling industrial production below 100 (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the unemployment rate above 5.5% combined with a 3-month decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) below $400 billion signals a significant labor market deterioration and demand contraction, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: labor market weakening and demand contraction
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of rising unemployment above 5.5% and falling real personal consumption expenditures below $400 billion (t-test p > 0.05).
